question: How many tracks are in the catalog?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Track

question: Which artist has the most albums?
gold_sql: SELECT ar.Name FROM Artist ar JOIN Album al ON al.ArtistId = ar.ArtistId GROUP BY ar.ArtistId ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1

question: How many customers are there in each country? Show country and count.
gold_sql: SELECT Country, COUNT(*) FROM Customer GROUP BY Country

question: What was the total invoice revenue for each year?
gold_sql: SELECT strftime('%Y', InvoiceDate) AS year, ROUND(SUM(Total), 2) FROM Invoice GROUP BY year

question: Who are the top 5 customers by total amount spent? Give their full name and the amount.
gold_sql: SELECT c.FirstName || ' ' || c.LastName, ROUND(SUM(i.Total), 2) AS spent FROM Customer c JOIN Invoice i ON i.CustomerId = c.CustomerId GROUP BY c.CustomerId ORDER BY spent DESC LIMIT 5

question: Which support rep looks after the most customers? Give the employee's full name.
gold_sql: SELECT e.FirstName || ' ' || e.LastName FROM Employee e JOIN Customer c ON c.SupportRepId = e.EmployeeId GROUP BY e.EmployeeId ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1

question: How many tracks are in the Grunge playlist?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM PlaylistTrack pt JOIN Playlist p ON p.PlaylistId = pt.PlaylistId WHERE p.Name = 'Grunge'

question: How many tracks have never been purchased?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Track WHERE TrackId NOT IN (SELECT TrackId FROM InvoiceLine)

question: Which billing country generated the most revenue in 2012?
gold_sql: SELECT BillingCountry FROM Invoice WHERE strftime('%Y', InvoiceDate) = '2012' GROUP BY BillingCountry ORDER BY SUM(Total) DESC LIMIT 1

question: Which artists have tracks in more than 3 different genres? List the artist names.
gold_sql: SELECT ar.Name FROM Artist ar JOIN Album al ON al.ArtistId = ar.ArtistId JOIN Track t ON t.AlbumId = al.AlbumId GROUP BY ar.ArtistId HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT t.GenreId) > 3

question: What percentage of total sales revenue does each genre account for? Show genre and percentage rounded to 2 decimals.
gold_sql: SELECT g.Name, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(il.UnitPrice * il.Quantity) / (SELECT SUM(UnitPrice * Quantity) FROM InvoiceLine), 2) FROM InvoiceLine il JOIN Track t ON t.TrackId = il.TrackId JOIN Genre g ON g.GenreId = t.GenreId GROUP BY g.GenreId

question: How many customers have bought at least one Rock track but never a Jazz track?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT i.CustomerId) FROM Invoice i JOIN InvoiceLine il ON il.InvoiceId = i.InvoiceId JOIN Track t ON t.TrackId = il.TrackId JOIN Genre g ON g.GenreId = t.GenreId WHERE g.Name = 'Rock' AND i.CustomerId NOT IN (SELECT i2.CustomerId FROM Invoice i2 JOIN InvoiceLine il2 ON il2.InvoiceId = i2.InvoiceId JOIN Track t2 ON t2.TrackId = il2.TrackId JOIN Genre g2 ON g2.GenreId = t2.GenreId WHERE g2.Name = 'Jazz')

question: In 2011, which month had the highest invoice revenue? Give the month number (1-12).
gold_sql: SELECT CAST(strftime('%m', InvoiceDate) AS INTEGER) AS m FROM Invoice WHERE strftime('%Y', InvoiceDate) = '2011' GROUP BY m ORDER BY SUM(Total) DESC LIMIT 1

question: Which employees have no customers assigned to them as support rep? Give full names.
gold_sql: SELECT FirstName || ' ' || LastName FROM Employee WHERE EmployeeId NOT IN (SELECT SupportRepId FROM Customer WHERE SupportRepId IS NOT NULL)

question: How many customers made their very first purchase in 2010?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT CustomerId, MIN(InvoiceDate) AS f FROM Invoice GROUP BY CustomerId) WHERE strftime('%Y', f) = '2010'

question: Which album has the longest total running time? Give the title and the length in minutes rounded to 1 decimal.
gold_sql: SELECT al.Title, ROUND(SUM(t.Milliseconds) / 60000.0, 1) AS mins FROM Album al JOIN Track t ON t.AlbumId = al.AlbumId GROUP BY al.AlbumId ORDER BY SUM(t.Milliseconds) DESC LIMIT 1

question: What was the year-over-year percentage change in invoice revenue for each year after the first, rounded to 1 decimal?
gold_sql: SELECT y, ROUND(100.0 * (rev - prev) / prev, 1) FROM (SELECT y, rev, LAG(rev) OVER (ORDER BY y) AS prev FROM (SELECT strftime('%Y', InvoiceDate) AS y, SUM(Total) AS rev FROM Invoice GROUP BY y)) WHERE prev IS NOT NULL

question: How many customers spent more than the average total spend per customer?
gold_sql: WITH s AS (SELECT CustomerId, SUM(Total) AS t FROM Invoice GROUP BY CustomerId) SELECT COUNT(*) FROM s WHERE t > (SELECT AVG(t) FROM s)

question: Which playlist contains tracks by the largest number of distinct artists? Give the playlist name.
gold_sql: SELECT p.Name FROM Playlist p JOIN PlaylistTrack pt ON pt.PlaylistId = p.PlaylistId JOIN Track t ON t.TrackId = pt.TrackId JOIN Album al ON al.AlbumId = t.AlbumId GROUP BY p.PlaylistId ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT al.ArtistId) DESC LIMIT 1
note: Playlists 1 and 8 are both named 'Music' and tie; asking for the name keeps it unambiguous.
alt_gold_sql: WITH c AS (SELECT p.PlaylistId, p.Name, COUNT(DISTINCT al.ArtistId) AS n FROM Playlist p JOIN PlaylistTrack pt ON pt.PlaylistId = p.PlaylistId JOIN Track t ON t.TrackId = pt.TrackId JOIN Album al ON al.AlbumId = t.AlbumId GROUP BY p.PlaylistId) SELECT Name FROM c WHERE n = (SELECT MAX(n) FROM c)

question: How many invoices contain tracks from more than one genre?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT il.InvoiceId FROM InvoiceLine il JOIN Track t ON t.TrackId = il.TrackId GROUP BY il.InvoiceId HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT t.GenreId) > 1)

question: Whose customers generated the most invoice revenue in 2010? Give the support rep's full name.
gold_sql: SELECT e.FirstName || ' ' || e.LastName FROM Invoice i JOIN Customer c ON c.CustomerId = i.CustomerId JOIN Employee e ON e.EmployeeId = c.SupportRepId WHERE strftime('%Y', i.InvoiceDate) = '2010' GROUP BY e.EmployeeId ORDER BY SUM(i.Total) DESC LIMIT 1

question: How many products are discontinued?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Products WHERE Discontinued = '1'

question: List the company names of suppliers based in Germany.
gold_sql: SELECT CompanyName FROM Suppliers WHERE Country = 'Germany'

question: Which category has the most products?
gold_sql: SELECT c.CategoryName FROM Categories c JOIN Products p ON p.CategoryID = c.CategoryID GROUP BY c.CategoryID ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1

question: How many orders were placed in each year?
gold_sql: SELECT strftime('%Y', OrderDate) AS y, COUNT(*) FROM Orders GROUP BY y

question: What is the average freight cost per shipper? Show shipper name and average rounded to 2 decimals.
gold_sql: SELECT s.CompanyName, ROUND(AVG(o.Freight), 2) FROM Orders o JOIN Shippers s ON s.ShipperID = o.ShipVia GROUP BY s.ShipperID

question: Which employees report directly to Andrew Fuller? Give their full names.
gold_sql: SELECT e.FirstName || ' ' || e.LastName FROM Employees e JOIN Employees m ON e.ReportsTo = m.EmployeeID WHERE m.FirstName = 'Andrew' AND m.LastName = 'Fuller'

question: Which employee handled the most orders in 2020? Give the full name.
gold_sql: SELECT e.FirstName || ' ' || e.LastName FROM Orders o JOIN Employees e ON e.EmployeeID = o.EmployeeID WHERE strftime('%Y', o.OrderDate) = '2020' GROUP BY e.EmployeeID ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1

question: How many products cost more than the average product unit price?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Products WHERE UnitPrice > (SELECT AVG(UnitPrice) FROM Products)

question: How many orders were shipped to France?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Orders WHERE ShipCountry = 'France'

question: What are the top 5 products by total sales revenue after discounts? Show product name and revenue rounded to 2 decimals.
gold_sql: SELECT p.ProductName, ROUND(SUM(od.UnitPrice * od.Quantity * (1 - od.Discount)), 2) AS rev FROM "Order Details" od JOIN Products p ON p.ProductID = od.ProductID GROUP BY p.ProductID ORDER BY rev DESC LIMIT 5

question: For each category, what is the most expensive product? Show category name, product name and unit price.
gold_sql: SELECT c.CategoryName, p.ProductName, p.UnitPrice FROM Products p JOIN Categories c ON c.CategoryID = p.CategoryID WHERE p.UnitPrice = (SELECT MAX(p2.UnitPrice) FROM Products p2 WHERE p2.CategoryID = p.CategoryID)

question: Which customer generated the most revenue (after discounts) in 2021? Give the company name.
gold_sql: SELECT c.CompanyName FROM Orders o JOIN "Order Details" od ON od.OrderID = o.OrderID JOIN Customers c ON c.CustomerID = o.CustomerID WHERE strftime('%Y', o.OrderDate) = '2021' GROUP BY c.CustomerID ORDER BY SUM(od.UnitPrice * od.Quantity * (1 - od.Discount)) DESC LIMIT 1

question: In 2021, which month had the most orders? Give the month number (1-12).
gold_sql: SELECT CAST(strftime('%m', OrderDate) AS INTEGER) AS m FROM Orders WHERE strftime('%Y', OrderDate) = '2021' GROUP BY m ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1

question: Which employee handled the most orders in 1997?
note: This copy of Northwind has no 1997 orders (dates span 2012-2023); the right outcome is to say so.

question: How many orders were shipped after their required date?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Orders WHERE ShippedDate IS NOT NULL AND ShippedDate > RequiredDate

question: On average, how many days pass between order date and ship date for shipped orders? Round to 1 decimal.
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(julianday(ShippedDate) - julianday(OrderDate)), 1) FROM Orders WHERE ShippedDate IS NOT NULL

question: How many products that are still sold (not discontinued) have units in stock below their reorder level?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Products WHERE Discontinued = '0' AND UnitsInStock < ReorderLevel

question: Customers from which country placed the most orders in 2019?
gold_sql: SELECT c.Country FROM Orders o JOIN Customers c ON c.CustomerID = o.CustomerID WHERE strftime('%Y', o.OrderDate) = '2019' GROUP BY c.Country ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1

question: What percentage of 2023 sales revenue (after discounts) came from the Beverages category? Round to 1 decimal.
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN c.CategoryName = 'Beverages' THEN od.UnitPrice * od.Quantity * (1 - od.Discount) END) / SUM(od.UnitPrice * od.Quantity * (1 - od.Discount)), 1) FROM Orders o JOIN "Order Details" od ON od.OrderID = o.OrderID JOIN Products p ON p.ProductID = od.ProductID JOIN Categories c ON c.CategoryID = p.CategoryID WHERE strftime('%Y', o.OrderDate) = '2023'

question: How many customers placed at least one order in every month of 2020?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT CustomerID FROM Orders WHERE strftime('%Y', OrderDate) = '2020' GROUP BY CustomerID HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT strftime('%m', OrderDate)) = 12)

question: Which employee has the highest average order value, where an order's value is the sum of its lines after discount? Give the full name.
gold_sql: SELECT e.FirstName || ' ' || e.LastName FROM (SELECT o.OrderID, o.EmployeeID, SUM(od.UnitPrice * od.Quantity * (1 - od.Discount)) AS v FROM Orders o JOIN "Order Details" od ON od.OrderID = o.OrderID GROUP BY o.OrderID) x JOIN Employees e ON e.EmployeeID = x.EmployeeID GROUP BY e.EmployeeID ORDER BY AVG(x.v) DESC LIMIT 1

question: Which supplier's products generated the most sales revenue (after discounts) in 2018? Give the supplier company name.
gold_sql: SELECT s.CompanyName FROM Orders o JOIN "Order Details" od ON od.OrderID = o.OrderID JOIN Products p ON p.ProductID = od.ProductID JOIN Suppliers s ON s.SupplierID = p.SupplierID WHERE strftime('%Y', o.OrderDate) = '2018' GROUP BY s.SupplierID ORDER BY SUM(od.UnitPrice * od.Quantity * (1 - od.Discount)) DESC LIMIT 1
